rule.indicative: fewer than 999 permutations, or an unavailable size reading
rule.power: per target pair (magnitude/delta, orientation/angle, shape/shape): informative_from = the smallest effect whose rate >= power_floor, else null; off-target and rank-stratified rates are descriptive
rule.size: anchor and translation, every statistic: rate (p <= alpha) <= alpha + k*sqrt(alpha(1-alpha)/R), R the available replicates; size holds when all six readings hold
rule.verdict: diagnose_design_excess when any size reading exceeds; else power_statement when a target statistic has an informative effect; else non_rejections_uninformative

consequence: no power statement is issued; the roadmap names the exceeding readings and a diagnosis of them as the next step before any statement is adopted

size.sentence: Size exceeds at the ADNI design: translation `angle` 0.150 (bound 0.1475, R = 20) above the one-sided bound. All six readings: anchor `delta` 0.100 (bound 0.1475, R = 20); anchor `angle` 0.000 (bound 0.1475, R = 20); anchor `shape` 0.100 (bound 0.1475, R = 20); translation `delta` 0.050 (bound 0.1475, R = 20); translation `angle` 0.150 (bound 0.1475, R = 20); translation `shape` 0.000 (bound 0.1475, R = 20).

calibration_realized.role: descriptive; the calibration criteria realized at the run's anchor units
calibration_realized.unadjusted_rejects: not run in the paper-grade profile (calibration only)

categorical.role: declared as a factor (drop-first category[c1], category[c2]); not injected (s_c = 0)

phase.column: numeric 0/1 (one design column; the LS-mean reference row sits at the pooled proportion)
phase.distribution: Bernoulli per group x stage cell at the table's shares

phase.direction: dense, iid N(0, 1) per feature of the block, drawn once from the base seed
phase.effect: X_f += s_p * sd_f * d_f * phase, after the z injection
phase.scale: pooled feature SD of the block as received (after the z injection)

injection.scale: pooled feature SD on the analysed scale
